mapper.select: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sa_project_member WHERE project_id=#{projectId} AND role='LEARNER' AND status='ACTIVE') activeLearners, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sa_onboarding_assignment WHERE project_id=#{projectId} AND status NOT IN ('PASSED','NEEDS_WORK','CANCELLED')) activeAssignments, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(status IN ('PASSED','NEEDS_WORK')) / NULLIF(COUNT(*),0),0) FROM sa_onboarding_assignment WHERE project_id=#{projectId}) assignmentCompletionRate, (SELECT COALESCE(AVG(passed),0) FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN (SELECT ar.decision FROM sa_assessment_review ar WHERE ar.project_id=qa.project_id AND ar.target_type='QUIZ_ATTEMPT' AND ar.target_id=qa.id ORDER BY ar.id DESC LIMIT 1) IS NOT NULL THEN (SELECT ar.decision='PASS' FROM sa_assessment_review ar WHERE ar.project_id=qa.project_id AND ar.target_type='QUIZ_ATTEMPT' AND ar.target_id=qa.id ORDER BY ar.id DESC LIMIT 1) ELSE qa.final_score >= q.pass_score END passed FROM sa_quiz_attempt qa JOIN sa_quiz q ON q.id=qa.quiz_id WHERE qa.project_id=#{projectId} AND qa.status='COMPLETED' AND qa.final_score IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT CASE WHEN (SELECT ar.decision FROM sa_assessment_review ar WHERE ar.project_id=r.project_id AND ar.target_type='DRILL_RUN' AND ar.target_id=r.id ORDER BY ar.id DESC LIMIT 1) IS NOT NULL THEN (SELECT ar.decision='PASS' FROM sa_assessment_review ar WHERE ar.project_id=r.project_id AND ar.target_type='DRILL_RUN' AND ar.target_id=r.id ORDER BY ar.id DESC LIMIT 1) ELSE r.pass_candidate=1 AND r.final_score >= s.pass_score END passed FROM sa_drill_run r JOIN sa_drill_scenario s ON s.id=r.scenario_id WHERE r.project_id=#{projectId} AND r.status='COMPLETED' AND r.final_score IS NOT NULL ) results) assessmentPassRate, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sa_content_dependency WHERE project_id=#{projectId} AND review_status='NEEDS_REVIEW') pendingKnowledgeReviews, ((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sa_quiz_attempt qa WHERE qa.project_id=#{projectId} AND qa.status='REVIEW_PENDING') + (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sa_drill_run r WHERE r.project_id=#{projectId} AND r.status='REVIEW_PENDING') + (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sa_onboarding_assignment a WHERE a.project_id=#{projectId} AND a.status='REVIEW_PENDING')) pendingAssessmentReviews, 0 knowledgeGapCount

SELECT a.id assignmentId,a.path_id pathId,p.name pathName,a.path_version pathVersion,a.assignee_user_id assigneeUserId, u.nickname assigneeName,a.status,a.progress,a.due_at dueAt,a.submitted_at submittedAt, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN t.required=1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) requiredTasks, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN t.required=1 AND t.status='COMPLETED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) completedRequiredTasks FROM sa_onboarding_assignment a JOIN sa_onboarding_path p ON p.id=a.path_id JOIN sa_user u ON u.id=a.assignee_user_id LEFT JOIN sa_onboarding_assignment_task t ON t.assignment_id=a.id WHERE a.project_id=#{projectId} GROUP BY a.id ORDER BY a.update_time DESC,a.id DESC

WITH facts AS ( SELECT qq.knowledge_key,qa.user_id,IF(qq.type='SHORT','SHORT','QUIZ') metric, IF(qq.type='SHORT',IF(ans.final_score<qq.max_score*0.6,1,0),IF(ans.is_correct=0,1,0)) bad,0 risk FROM sa_quiz_answer ans JOIN sa_quiz_attempt qa ON qa.id=ans.attempt_id JOIN sa_quiz q ON q.id=qa.quiz_id JOIN sa_quiz_question qq ON qq.id=ans.question_id WHERE qa.project_id=#{projectId} AND qa.status='COMPLETED' AND qq.knowledge_key IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT rule.knowledge_key,r.user_id,'REQUIRED' metric, IF(NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM sa_drill_run_action a WHERE a.run_id=r.id AND a.matched_rule_id=rule.id),1,0) bad,0 risk FROM sa_drill_rule rule JOIN sa_drill_scenario s ON s.id=rule.scenario_id JOIN sa_drill_run r ON r.scenario_id=s.id AND r.status='COMPLETED' WHERE s.project_id=#{projectId} AND rule.knowledge_key IS NOT NULL AND rule.rule_type IN ('REQUIRED','VALIDATION') UNION ALL SELECT rule.knowledge_key,r.user_id,'RISKY' metric,0 bad, IF(EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM sa_drill_run_action a WHERE a.run_id=r.id AND a.matched_rule_id=rule.id AND a.risk_flag=1),1,0) risk FROM sa_drill_rule rule JOIN sa_drill_scenario s ON s.id=rule.scenario_id JOIN sa_drill_run r ON r.scenario_id=s.id AND r.status='COMPLETED' WHERE s.project_id=#{projectId} AND rule.knowledge_key IS NOT NULL AND rule.rule_type='RISKY' ) SELECT knowledge_key knowledgeKey,knowledge_key label,COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) participantCount, SUM(metric='QUIZ' AND bad=1) quizWrong,SUM(metric='QUIZ') quizTotal, SUM(metric='SHORT' AND bad=1) shortLow,SUM(metric='SHORT') shortTotal, SUM(metric='REQUIRED' AND bad=1) drillMiss,SUM(metric='REQUIRED') drillRequired, SUM(metric='RISKY' AND risk=1) riskHit,SUM(metric='RISKY') riskTotal FROM facts GROUP BY knowledge_key HAVING SUM(bad)>0 OR SUM(risk)>0 ORDER BY (SUM(bad)+SUM(risk)) DESC,knowledge_key

SELECT DISTINCT source.knowledgeKey,source.documentId FROM ( SELECT qq.knowledge_key knowledgeKey,cd.source_document_id documentId FROM sa_content_dependency cd JOIN sa_quiz q ON cd.target_type='QUIZ' AND cd.target_id=q.id JOIN sa_quiz_question qq ON qq.quiz_id=q.id WHERE cd.project_id=#{projectId} AND cd.review_status='NEEDS_REVIEW' AND qq.knowledge_key IS NOT NULL UNION SELECT rule.knowledge_key knowledgeKey,cd.source_document_id documentId FROM sa_content_dependency cd JOIN sa_drill_scenario s ON cd.target_type='DRILL' AND cd.target_id=s.id JOIN sa_drill_rule rule ON rule.scenario_id=s.id WHERE cd.project_id=#{projectId} AND cd.review_status='NEEDS_REVIEW' AND rule.knowledge_key IS NOT NULL ) source ORDER BY source.knowledgeKey,source.documentId

SELECT 'QUIZ_ATTEMPT' targetType,qa.id targetId,qa.user_id userId,u.nickname userName,q.title, qa.status,qa.auto_score automaticScore,qa.final_score finalScore,qa.submitted_at submittedAt FROM sa_quiz_attempt qa JOIN sa_quiz q ON q.id=qa.quiz_id JOIN sa_user u ON u.id=qa.user_id WHERE qa.project_id=#{projectId} AND qa.status='REVIEW_PENDING' UNION ALL SELECT 'DRILL_RUN',r.id,r.user_id,u.nickname,s.name,r.status,r.program_score,r.final_score,r.submitted_at FROM sa_drill_run r JOIN sa_drill_scenario s ON s.id=r.scenario_id JOIN sa_user u ON u.id=r.user_id WHERE r.project_id=#{projectId} AND r.status='REVIEW_PENDING' UNION ALL SELECT 'ASSIGNMENT',a.id,a.assignee_user_id,u.nickname,p.name,a.status,NULL,NULL,a.submitted_at FROM sa_onboarding_assignment a JOIN sa_onboarding_path p ON p.id=a.path_id JOIN sa_user u ON u.id=a.assignee_user_id WHERE a.project_id=#{projectId} AND a.status='REVIEW_PENDING' ORDER BY submittedAt,targetType,targetId
